discription: A plucky square wave synth with a short decay envelope and a low-pass filter for shaping.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5;var sig, env;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5);sig = LPF.ar(sig, freq * 4, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
